title: Loukoumades with Honey-Caramel Sauce
description: Crispy Greek doughnuts served with a sweet and sticky honey-caramel sauce. Perfect for a dessert or snack.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Punch down the loukoumades dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thickness and use a cookie cutter to cut out circles.
Fry the loukoumades for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain the loukoumades on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, heat the honey and caramel syrup over low heat.
Stir until the sauce is smooth and warm.
Dip the fried loukoumades in the honey-caramel sauce and serve warm.
